_about: id/description for each hooks.json hook-group entry, keyed by event + array position, with a command fingerprint so a reorder or same-count replacement can't silently mismatch. hooks.json's own schema (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) only recognizes matcher/hooks at that level -- CC warns and drops id/description if left inline (2026-09-10). This is the canonical source for the id vocabulary docs/ cites by name. Hand-maintained, no generator, same stance as docs/reference/codex-integration-map.md:69.

SessionStart.description: Export ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} into the session as ${MH_PLUGIN_ROOT} so skill markdown can reference bundled scripts portably.
Inject docs/METHODOLOGY.md whole into session context, plus python3/jq/node preflight notes.
Surface memory-lint findings (dangling links, orphans, index drift) at session start; silent when clean.

Surface a one-line pointer per writing-fragments document with an unseen on-disk change since it was last shown; silent when none. Records the new snapshot for what it shows and sweeps stale TMPDIR arm state.

Reprint every on-record writing-fragments document unconditionally after a compact, ignoring the snapshot-diff filter; never records. A fragments file's one stated path is exactly what compaction loses, so this ignores compact's own scoping.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Arm a per-invocation marker when the prompt invokes mattpocock-skills:writing-fragments, so a qualifying write shortly after can be captured as a pointer; silent otherwise. May also inject a known-path nudge if this project already has a document on record.

UserPromptExpansion.description: Journal each user-typed /skill (slash_command expansion) to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/skill-usage.jsonl with source typed. A typed skill never makes a Skill tool call, so the PostToolUse(Skill) entry alone misses it (GH #330). Audit logging only, never blocks.

PreToolUse.description: Deny irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, find -delete, --no-verify, hooksPath, push --force, reset --hard, clean -f, checkout/restore discards, switch --force, branch -D (except a plain git branch -D <names> without main/master/develop), stash drop/clear, commit --amend, git add -A/. outside a merge, dd to a device, SQL DROP/TRUNCATE) and a subagent spawning a nested claude -p/--print/--agent/--bg/--worktree session.
Deny (subagent only): git stash (except list/show), reset, clean -- no repo-wide git inside a concurrent wave.
Deny (subagent only): a subagent may not call the Agent tool to spawn its own reviewer/validator/subagent -- dispatch is the main session's job.
Deny (subagent only): a subagent may not mark its own task completed; only the main session completes tasks.
Ask when an edit to an existing test-shaped path removes an assertion line or adds a skip/disable marker.
Ask before creating a Claude Code settings file, or editing an existing one's hooks / enabledPlugins / env keys.

Ask when a Write/Edit introduces a new vendor-specific live-credential token (AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, GitLab, HuggingFace, Slack, Stripe secret/restricted, Google API key, npm, PyPI, PEM private key) that isn't a canonical placeholder or same-line-suppressed.
Ask before a model-invoked Skill(codex:setup) call carrying --enable-review-gate; the paired Codex plugin's review gate stays off by design.

Deny (re-prompt) a SubagentHandback call whose report (tool_input.message) carries a vacuous or self-contradictory Rule 13 verdict object -- the auto-mode delivery path SubagentStop cannot see (GH #160).

Ask before RemoteTrigger creates, updates, runs, or wires a webhook onto a Routine (mutating/firing actions only, not list/get/list_runs/get_run_log) -- interactive-session-only, cannot constrain a Routine already running outside this session (ADR 0004). CronCreate is out of scope: session-only, no new credential.

Advisory only, never blocks: before a Codex CLI Bash command runs, warn via additionalContext if codex-quota-sensor recently recorded a usage-limit/rate-limit failure. Stale records past the TTL self-clear.

PostToolUse.description: After a Bash call, replace vendor-specific credential-shaped tokens (secret-scan.py's PATTERNS) in stdout/stderr with a [REDACTED:kind] marker via PostToolUse updatedToolOutput. Bash only (Read output was not rewritable, probed 2026-10-22, GH #534); best-effort; fails open, never denies.

If this session is armed (sensor:prompt:fragments-arm) and this write plausibly targets a writing-fragments document, record a durable path pointer to it; never touches or inlines content, never prints anything.

Journal each model-called skill (skill, plugin, ts, source tool; a short name is mapped to its namespaced form when one installed plugin ships it) to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/skill-usage.jsonl. User-typed skills are caught by session:skill-usage-telemetry-typed. Audit logging only, restored 2026-09-20 (harness gap-audit H9) after deletion in a1055f64.

PostToolUseFailure.description: Advisory only, never blocks: on a non-zero exit, nudge diagnose-before-retry via additionalContext. Capped at 1 per distinct failing command per session, and per subagent within it (a subagent shares its parent's session_id, so the counter also keys on agent_id). Registered on PostToolUseFailure (not PostToolUse): that is where a nonzero Bash exit dispatches, and its output schema declares additionalContext; provenance in the sensor's docstring.

Advisory only, never blocks: on a Codex CLI Bash command failing with a usage-limit/rate-limit-shaped error, record the failure (persisted, not session-scoped) so codex-quota-advisory can warn before the next Codex dispatch.

Stop.description: Track cumulative token and cost metrics per session; appends to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/costs.jsonl.
If the project's memory store is already a git repo (opt-in), commit any dirty changes for an audit trail. No-op otherwise.

SubagentStop.description: Block (re-prompt once) a subagent's Stop when its final message carries a vacuous or self-contradictory Rule 13 {pass, findings[], checked[], scope_ok, unexpected_files[]} verdict object.
